description: A maximum-wait bound guarantees that a continuously re-triggered debounced function still runs no later than the configured maximum wait measured from the first invocation of the burst, even though each new invocation would otherwise keep resetting the quiet period and indefinitely postpone execution. When the maximum wait elapses, the function runs once with the arguments of the most recent invocation seen so far.
